newsitem.title: USA: Layne files 5 mln share public offering.
newsitem.headline: Layne files 5 mln share public offering.

text.p: Layne Christensen Co said it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of up to five million shares of its common stock.
In a release dated June 19, the company said 1.7 million will be sold by the company and 3.3 million will be sold by certain stockholders.
Layne said it entends to use the proceeds to reduce the debt that it expects to incur with its tender offer for Stanley Mining Services Ltd, launched in April.
It expects that deal to be completed in August 1997, subject to the tender of at least 90 percent of the shares.
The offering will be underwritten by Piper Jaffray Inc and Dillon, Read & Co Inc.
